item.text: I’ll trace how inline code spans are tokenized and how their trailing backslashes interact with the inline delimiter scanner, then make the smallest source fix.

item.text: The bug is in the emphasis mask: code spans are masked only after escaped punctuation is masked, so a backslash inside a code span can hide emphasis delimiters later on the line. I’ll fix the masking order in `src/Lexer.ts`.
